title: Registration, Plate and Title Delivery Timelines for Title & Registration Services
content:
**Desk reference.** Registration under Title & Registration Services is normally issued within the registration target of the service type, counted in calendar days after the order opens; plates and the registration card, title-only paperwork and paper titles then go out within the mailing periods below, each counted in business days.

| Service type | Registration normally issued within (calendar days after opening) | Plates and registration card mailed within (business days after registration is issued) | Title-only paperwork mailed within (business days after the title is issued; 0 means not title-only) | Paper title mailed to an owner with no lien within (business days after Kestrel receives it from the state) | Lienholder on the purchase recorded on the new title |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Title-Only Service | 30 | 0 | 5 | 10 | Yes |
| Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer | 30 | 10 | 0 | 10 | Yes |
| Kestrel In-State New Registration | 30 | 10 | 0 | 10 | Yes |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | 45 | 15 | 0 | 10 | Yes |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | 60 | 15 | 0 | 10 | Yes |
| Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration | 60 | 20 | 0 | 10 | Yes |

**Electronic-title states.** For every service type the registration states that issue an electronic title held by the lienholder, rather than a paper title, are AZ, TX, GA, FL, NC, OH, PA and CO.

## Reading the timelines

- Kestrel Title-Only Service mails no plates (its plate period is 0); it mails title-only paperwork within 5 business days of the title being issued. Every other service type shows 0 in the title-only column and mails plates and the registration card instead.
- The registration target is counted from the opening date, while every mailing period starts from a later event: registration issued, title issued, or the paper title received from the state.
- Hypothetical illustration: a Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration order opened on 1 April is normally registered within 60 calendar days, by 31 May; once registration is issued, plates and the registration card go out within 20 business days.
